remarks: Welcome home at Springview Terrace! A light, bright and comfortable 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath unit awaits its next loving and caring owner. Through the front door you are greeted by a spacious yet cozy living room. The living space transitions into a bright dining area complete with sliders to the back patio, as well as a modern kitchen and a half-bath/laundry setup- making your daily routine easy and comfortable. Hardwood floors throughout along with natural sunlight make for an enjoyable vibe and living experience. The back patio/seating area is accompanied by a garden bed and views of Michael J. Drotar Park. Two storage units are found in the shared basement, with outdoor access conveniently located near the back entrance to the unit. Springdale Elementary is right around the corner. The restaurants, cafes and shopping of Springdale is within touching distance right down the street. For commuters, both Springdale Train Station and the Merrit Parkway are just 5 minutes away! and ! Also within 5 minutes are both Stamford Twin Rinks and the Sterling Farms public golf course. Vibrant downtown Stamford is a mere 10-15 minutes. Come enjoy life at Springview Terrace!
